lessons.title: Writing New Year Resolutions
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write a simple sentence about a goal for the new year.
success_criteria: I can write a goal.
I can use a capital letter and full stop.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what a New Year resolution is.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Model writing a simple sentence about a New Year goal.
lessons.independent_task: Children write 1-2 sentences about their own New Year goal.
key_questions: What is your goal for this year?
Can you write a sentence about it?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective writing to start the new term — evidence for ENG.W2/W3.
lessons.plenary: Share New Year goals with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family your New Year goal.

lessons.title: Number Recap: Counting and Place Value to 100
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure counting and place value understanding to 100.
success_criteria: I can count confidently to 100.
I can represent numbers using tens and ones.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap counting and place value from the Autumn term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate counting to 100 and place value using base-10 blocks.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a counting and place value consolidation activity.
key_questions: How many tens and ones make this number?
Can you count confidently to 100?
lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline check at the start of Spring term — evidence for MATHS.N1.
lessons.plenary: Recap readiness for Spring term number work.
lessons.home_link: Practise counting and place value together.

lessons.title: Story Time: A New Year Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to discuss the theme of new beginnings in a story.
success_criteria: I can say what was new in the story.
I can compare it to my own new beginnings.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss new things children have this term (a new topic, new goal).
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a story about new beginnings, modelling discussion of the theme.
lessons.independent_task: Children discuss and record connections between the story and their own new beginnings.
key_questions: What was new in the story?
What is new for you this term?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension and personal connection to a theme — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.plenary: Recap the story's new beginnings theme.
lessons.home_link: Talk about something new you're looking forward to.

lessons.title: Addition and Subtraction to 100: Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure addition and subtraction skills to 100.
success_criteria: I can add two-digit numbers.
I can subtract two-digit numbers.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap addition and subtraction strategies from the Autumn term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate two-digit addition and subtraction using number lines and known facts.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete an addition and subtraction consolidation activity.
key_questions: What strategy will you use?
Can you solve this without a number line?
lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline check at the start of Spring term for addition/subtraction — evidence for MATHS.N2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate progress in addition and subtraction.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising addition and subtraction over the week.

lessons.title: Phonics: Spring Term Sounds Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read words using a full range of sounds learned so far.
success_criteria: I can blend and read a range of words.
I can read a short passage.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the full range of graphemes and spelling patterns learned this year.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate reading using a mixed range of graphemes and spelling patterns.
lessons.independent_task: Children read a short mixed passage, demonstrating fluency.
key_questions: Can you read this word?
Can you read this passage fluently?

differentiation.support: Read with support, focusing on core patterns

lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline phonics/spelling check for the Spring term — evidence for ENG.R1/W1.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress so far this year.

lessons.title: Multiplication and Division Recap: 2, 5, 10
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure recall of 2, 5 and 10 times table facts.
success_criteria: I can recall 2, 5 and 10 times table facts.
I can solve related division facts.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate times table recall and related division facts.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a times tables and division consolidation activity.
key_questions: What is 6 x 5?
What is the related division fact?

differentiation.greater_depth: Recall all three times tables and related facts fluently

lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline check for the Spring term on times tables — evidence for MATHS.N3.
lessons.home_link: Practise the 2, 5 and 10 times tables together.

lessons.title: Sharing Our New Year Goals
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to present a personal goal clearly to the class.
success_criteria: I can share my goal.
I can answer a question about it.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Discuss what makes a clear presentation of a personal goal.
lessons.independent_task: Children present their New Year goal to a small group, answering a question.
key_questions: What is your goal?
How will you achieve it?

differentiation.greater_depth: Present unprompted with confidence and detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note spoken language progress at the start of term — evidence for ENG.SL1.
lessons.plenary: Vote on an inspiring goal shared.
lessons.home_link: Tell your family your New Year goal again and how it's going.

lessons.title: Fractions Recap: Halves, Quarters, Thirds
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate secure understanding of halves, quarters and thirds.
success_criteria: I can find a half, quarter and third confidently.
I can explain my method.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap fractions from the Autumn term.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Consolidate finding halves, quarters and thirds of shapes and quantities.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a fractions consolidation activity.
key_questions: What is a third of this?
What is a quarter of this?

differentiation.greater_depth: Solve without concrete resources where possible

lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline check for the Spring term on fractions — evidence for MATHS.N4.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate progress made in fractions this year so far.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising fractions over the week.

lessons.title: New Year Reading Comprehension
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer comprehension questions linked to new beginnings.
success_criteria: I can answer a retrieval question.
I can answer an inference question.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's new year theme.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Read a summary passage about new beginnings, modelling retrieval and inference questions.
lessons.independent_task: Children answer a mix of retrieval and inference questions about the passage.
key_questions: What was the character's goal?
Why might setting a goal help someone?

differentiation.support: Answer retrieval questions with text pointing

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension progress — evidence for ENG.R2.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on new year facts/ideas.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Full Number Consolidation
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to apply a full range of number skills in a mixed challenge.
success_criteria: I can count, add, subtract, multiply and divide confidently.
I can explain my strategies.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key vocabulary from the week.
lessons.main_teaching_input: Quick recap of the week's core number content.
lessons.independent_task: Children complete a comprehensive mixed review covering counting, place value, the four operations, and fractions.
key_questions: What strategy will you use?
Can you check your answer?

differentiation.support: Complete with reduced complexity and support

lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline consolidation summary for the Spring term, informing planning for the rest of the term.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate a strong start to the Spring term's maths.
lessons.home_link: Review the week's number learning together.
